prompt: What does the guide suggest about the normal feeding schedule during travel?
promptZh: 指南對旅途中原有的餵養作息有什麼建議？

options.text: A feeding due on the road can wait until the jar has warmed up at the destination.
options.zh: 若原本應在途中餵養，可等到目的地並讓罐子回溫後再餵。
options.whyZh: 途中不要開罐餵養；抵達後取出罐子，回溫才餵。

options.text: Feed at the usual time even if the jar is still in the cooler.
options.zh: 即使罐子還在保冷袋中，也照平常時間餵養。
options.whyZh: 在保冷袋期間暫停平常作息，不在途中餵養。

options.text: Keep the cooler open once the usual feeding time arrives.
options.zh: 一到平常餵養時間，就打開保冷袋。
options.whyZh: 應在抵達後取出罐子，不是按平時的餵養時間打開保冷袋。

options.text: Skip feeding for the whole trip, even after taking the jar out.
options.zh: 整趟旅行都不餵，即使已把罐子拿出來也一樣。
options.whyZh: 抵達後回溫就可以餵，不必一直等到旅行結束。

explanationZh: 途中不要開罐餵養；抵達後取出罐子，回溫才餵。
evidence: Don't open the jar to feed the starter on the way. / At your destination, take the jar out of the cooler and let it warm up before you feed it.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Don't open the jar to feed the starter on the way.
At your destination, take the jar out of the cooler and let it warm up before you feed it.

vocabulary.note: 從較冷的狀態逐漸升溫；這裡不是要加熱到很燙。
